reason: A web overlay widget that monitors configured AI-provider balances and quota usage through periodic API requests, with per-provider display settings and proxy configuration.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中展示已配置 AI 服务商的余额、配额和使用窗口，并支持自动刷新及按服务商调整显示设置。
summaries.en: A DSH web overlay that displays balances, quotas, and usage windows for configured AI providers with automatic refresh and per-provider display settings.

capabilities: Reads configured provider credentials on the host
Queries external provider quota and balance endpoints
Displays normalized quota and balance data in a web overlay
Stores display and refresh settings in browser localStorage
Supports user-configured HTTP or HTTPS proxy requests
Communicates between host and browser through a loopback RPC channel
